trans-unit.source: The Tria. It is said to be a triad of ancient artifacts.
trans-unit.target: The Tria. It is said to be a triad of ancient artifacts.

trans-unit.source: And, if fused together, they'll become a magic sword that can manipulate time.
trans-unit.target: And, if fused together, they'll become a magic sword that can manipulate time.

trans-unit.source: If we can get our hands on that, Dhaos can be chained to this era.
trans-unit.target: If we can get our hands on that, Dhaos can be chained to this era.

trans-unit.source: Let us search for these artifacts with all due haste!
